notes: τῷ θεῷ leaves the article unrepresented and keeps 'to' with the noun, the ASV supplying no determiner (rule 21's determinerless clause).
τῷ δυναμένῳ is rule 31's case, the article governing an expressed head noun, so 'which is' goes to the participle; τοῖς before ἡγιασμένοις is rule 32's substantival split.
The supplied object pronouns of 'build you up' and 'give you' are rule 7 helpers on their infinitives, not `added` under rule 103.
